reference_kind: TUM ground truth plus BF16 prediction
evaluation_protocol: Full-trajectory Sim(3) ATE/RPE; GT depth uses per-frame median scale alignment; BF16 depth consistency is unaligned.
calibration: Independent fr1/desk frames 192:352 and fr1/rpy frames 448:608, 320 frames total, 15 reconstruction epochs.
notes: BF16 consistency is not GT accuracy. Runtime differences are explicit; no causal speedup is inferred across hardware/cache changes. Memory uses decimal GB and includes startup. Process memory is sampled and can miss brief transients; allocated/reserved peaks are recorded separately.

pose_ground_truth.depth_alignment: official DepthEvaluator per-frame scale_only, GT clip (0,80)
pose_ground_truth.point_protocol: corresponding-pixel EPE after trajectory Sim3, not ICP/Chamfer reconstruction benchmark

depth_ground_truth.alignment: official per-frame median(GT) / median(prediction), not absolute metric scale
depth_ground_truth.mask: common finite GT pixels in (0,80)m; invalid predictions cause an error, no confidence filtering
